systems.system: digital platform for civil registration documents and production of the biometric national identity card
systems.country_label: plateforme numérique destinée à la gestion des documents d'état civil et à la production de la future carte nationale d'identité biométrique
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior, Community Development and Public Security
systems.tiers: pilot in about a dozen communes; extension planned nationally down to zone level

note: The platform is an application, in pilot in about a dozen communes; a connection is only envisaged (telecom operators Lumitel and Onatel as partners, internet routers and solar power considered), with internet connectivity named as a constraint, so no connection of commune offices is stated.
